description: ikm = the 16 UUID bytes; invite_id = base64url(HKDF-SHA256(ikm, salt = empty, info = 'xshell invite id v1', L = 16)); k_inv = HKDF-SHA256(ikm, salt = empty, info = 'xshell invite key v1', L = 32). Claimant: ephemeral X25519 pair e_j; req = base64url(nonce || XChaCha20-Poly1305(k_inv, nonce, UTF-8(JCS({v: 1, alias, role})), aad = UTF-8(invite_id) || epk_j (32 raw bytes))). Master: ephemeral X25519 pair e_m; shared = X25519(e_m.priv, epk_j) (= X25519(e_j.priv, epk_m), all-zero is refused); k_box = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = k_inv || shared, salt = empty, info = 'xshell invite box v2' || UTF-8(invite_id) || epk_j || epk_m, L = 32); box = base64url(epk_m || nonce || XChaCha20-Poly1305(k_box, nonce, UTF-8(JCS({v: 1, key: shell_key})), aad = UTF-8(invite_id)))
